layouts.name: Shelsley Walsh Hillclimb
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The open mapped hillclimb retains the Southern start approach and its small lower return, the Kennel bend, main climb and upper Esses. The operator identifies the hill and corner sequence; all route coordinates remain unchanged independent road nodes. The gate-to-gate source route measures 1017.1 m against the 1163 m catalogue scalar. The sparsely mapped upper straight has no existing node within 30 m of the finish: the nearest endpoint is 38.5 m away along the same road, whose perpendicular timing displacement is below 2 m. A documented 40 m endpoint allowance preserves that draft uncertainty without adding a fabricated vertex or extending to nearby footpaths. Timing extent and approach alignment remain provisional. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 1017.1 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
